consequence.statement: Middleware that previously applied Content-Type auto-detection by default will no longer do so; explicit configuration is required to restore the previous behavior.
consequence.remediation: Review middleware configurations using Content-Type auto-detection and explicitly enable it if the previous behavior is required.

original.statement: Content-Type auto-detection in Traefik middleware is now disabled by default.

decision.reason: [ev-ee73106833c6] says only that Content-Type auto-detection is now disabled by default. That is a changed default, and the evidence does not say that anything fails, is rejected or stops being honoured, so behavior-change (review) is the right kind. Saying it can be turned back on explicitly follows from the words "by default". The medium severity and the exact effect on responses are not stated in the evidence, which is why confidence is low.
